name: Pellax Rhenune
keeps: the oath he is named for breaking
does: Carries the chain across at the syndication and brings the other world's back. Signs for what he carried and for nothing else.
reason: Held that the stars were suns with worlds of their own.
text: Pellax rhenune of the ninth arch, carries between for the 17th tranche, doors 153 to 161. Keeps the oath he is named for breaking. Reads Giordano Bruno.
